capabilities: Syncs memos into per-file Markdown or daily notes
Sends quick captures, selections and notes to Memos
Manages multiple Memos accounts with per-account settings
Downloads memo attachments and embeds them as links

extras: Desktop only (Windows/macOS/Linux); requires Obsidian 1.8.7+. No telemetry; tokens and API keys stay in local data.json. Local edits are backed up to _冲突/ before overwrite; server-deleted memos go to _已删除/.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep a self-hosted Memos account in sync with vault notes or to send notes back to Memos.

relations.evidence: Sync your Memos into Obsidian — and send notes from Obsidian back to Memos.
